recipes.projection: Blended projection = weighted mean of Sleeper app x1, CBS Sports x1, ESPN fantasy x1, DraftKings points converted from each source's own stat lines. Weights renormalise over the sources that cover each player; coverage is the covering weight as a share of the total enabled weight. Coverage under 50% keeps the number from the sources that do cover the player and is flagged "thin"; it is never pulled toward a typical score for the salary. No coverage leaves the projection blank, flagged "no projection", unless the injury report lists the player as out, on IR, doubtful or suspended, in which case the projection is 0.
recipes.ownership: Own% is the average, by source weight, of the numbers Weekly findings file, Footballguys percent rostered and RotoWire projected roster % published for the DraftKings main slate; numbers for any other site or slate are never used. Stokastic DK cheat sheet is downloaded, stored and shown in its own column, but never averaged into Own% (weight 0). A number Adam types into the Own% cell replaces the published one for that player. A player with no published number is left blank: the app never estimates ownership, so game popularity exists only where a real number does.
recipes.scoring: DraftKings scoring from stat lines; 100/300-yard bonuses paid as 3 x probability from a lognormal (cv rush 0.55, rec 0.55, pass 0.30); DST points-allowed from a normal around the opponent's implied total (SD 9.5, shutout rate unvalidated)

injury.comment: Gibbs carried the ball 21 times for 205 yards and three touchdowns while catching all five of his targets for 47 yards in Thursday's 39-35 loss to the Bears.
injury.longComment: The superstar running back was already headed for a career-best season coming into Week 12, but Gibbs took things to another level on Thanksgiving, producing his third career game with three rushing scores and his second with 200-plus rushing yards. The 252 scrimmage yards also tied his season high, a mark he reached just two weeks ago against the Patriots. Gibbs leads the NFL with 1,754 scrimmage yards, and given his current form he could reach 2,000 as soon as next week, on the road against the Falcons.

injury.comment: Lamb caught seven of 11 targets for 134 yards in Thursday's 39-38 loss to the Eagles.
injury.longComment: He was once again Dak Prescott's top downfield option, leading the Cowboys in targets, catches and receiving yards, but KaVontae Turpin and Javonte Williams were on the other end of the QB's touchdown passes. Lamb has topped 100 yards in six of 12 games this season, including three of the last four, and he'll carry a 95-1,242-9 line on 144 targets into a tough Week 13 battle against the Seahawks.

injury.comment: St. Brown caught seven of 10 targets for 146 yards in Thursday's 39-35 loss to the Bears.
injury.longComment: It was the third time this season St. Brown has hauled in more than 140 yards in a game, but he got shut out of the end zone as Jahmyr Gibbs did most of the scoring for the Lions. St. Brown has caught at least seven passes in four of the last six games, and through 11 contests he's racked up a 77-938-8 line on 107 targets. He'll look to reach 1,000 yards for the fifth straight season in Week 13 on the road against the Falcons.

injury.comment: Cook rushed 32 times for 117 yards and a touchdown and brought in his only target for eight yards in the Bills' 13-10 win over the Chiefs on Thursday.
injury.longComment: Cook logged a season high in rush attempts while eclipsing the century mark for the third time in the last four games. Cook's longest gain went for only 10 yards, so he worked hard for everything he got against a tough Chiefs front. Cook added his 11th rushing touchdown of the season on a five-yard run early in the second quarter, and he'll have some extra recovery time before he takes aim at the Patriots defense in a Week 13 road matchup on Sunday, Dec. 6.

injury.comment: Johnson rushed 17 times for 72 yards and a touchdown and brought in all four targets for 24 yards in the Chiefs' 13-10 loss to the Bills on Thursday.
injury.longComment: Making a third straight start in place of Kenneth Walker (groin), Johnson put together another useful all-around performance that included his third rushing touchdown of the season on a one-yard run early in the third quarter. Johnson also recorded at least four catches for the third consecutive game, and he's now accumulated 410 scrimmage yards and four total TDs over his three starts. Walker is likely to be back for next Thursday's Week 13 road showdown against the Rams, but Johnson is likely to retain a solid complementary role even when his star teammate is back on the field.

injury.comment: Allen completed 10 of 21 passes for 81 yards with no touchdowns and two interceptions and added seven carries for 43 yards in the Bills' 13-10 win over the Chiefs on Thursday.
injury.longComment: Allen's abysmal numbers tell the tale of how difficult a night it was for the star signal-caller under less-than-ideal weather conditions and while facing a talented veteran defense. Allen's passing yardage total was a season low, and the two-interception  tally was his second straight. Allen also took a pair of sacks and completed a season-worst 47.6 percent of his passes, but he helped bring Buffalo back from a 10-7 fourth-quarter deficit. Allen's lackluster showing aside, he'll remain an elite option in all formats for a Week 13 road divisional clash against the Patriots on Sunday, Dec. 6.

injury.comment: Williams carried the ball 29 times for 101 yards and two touchdowns while catching all three of his targets for 22 yards and a third TD in Thursday's 39-38 loss to the Eagles.
injury.longComment: All three scores came in the first half as the Cowboys raced out to a 28-10 lead, making Williams the first player with three TDs in a half on Thanksgiving since Brian Westbrook accomplished the feat with Philly in 2008. Williams is also the second RB in Cowboys history to have multiple games in a season with three or more scores, something Emmitt Smith pulled off in four separate campaigns. He's also reached 100 rushing yards in three of the last six games, and he's topped 1,000 yards from scrimmage for the second straight year in Dallas. Williams will look to keep rolling in Week 13 against the Seahawks.

injury.comment: Prescott completed 19 of 28 passes for 291 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Thursday's 39-38 loss to the Eagles. He added 19 yards and a TD on two carries.
injury.longComment: The Cowboys held a 28-10 lead at the half and were up 38-24 early in the fourth quarter, but abysmal efforts by the defense and special teams squandered Prescott's third straight game producing at least three touchdowns. It was the first time since Week 8 that he failed to reach 300 passing yards, but the 33-year-old QB is still on course for a career-best campaign. He'll take a 27:7 TD:INT, along with three rushing scores, into a much tougher Week 13 tilt against the Seahawks.

injury.comment: Pickens caught five of nine targets for 67 yards in Thursday's 39-38 loss to the Eagles.
injury.longComment: It was a step back for Pickens after he hauled in 18 of 28 targets for 247 yards and four TDs over the prior two games. The 25-year-old wideout is the clear No. 2 option in the Dallas passing attack behind CeeDee Lamb, but the team's woeful defense and limited depth behind the duo ensures that Pickens will see big volume from Dak Prescott more often than not. Pickens will take a 62-847-6 line on 99 targets into a Week 13 clash with the Seahawks.

injury.comment: Swift carried the ball nine times for 65 yards and a touchdown and caught seven of eight targets for 97 yards in Thursday's 39-35 win over the Lions.
injury.longComment: While Kyle Monangai swooped in to score two TDs at the goal line, Swift put up impressive numbers of his own, leading the Bears in both rushing and receiving yards while hitting paydirt on a 30-yard run in the third quarter. The seven grabs and 97 receiving yards were both season highs for Swift, and the added volume came as a result of Colston Loveland's early exit due to a knee injury. If Loveland ends up missing more time, Swift's usage as a pass catcher could get a boost again in Week 13 against the Jaguars. He's already been plenty busy on that front this season, and through 11 contests he's compiled 959 scrimmage yards and a career-high 12 total TDs (10 rushing, two receiving).

injury.comment: Mahomes completed 16 of 29 passes for 174 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and rushed three times for two yards in the Chiefs' 13-10 loss to the Bills on Thursday. He also fumbled twice but recovered on each occasion.
injury.longComment: Like Josh Allen, Mahomes didn't come close to putting up his typical caliber of production in the poor weather conditions Thursday, although the latter was at least relatively efficient compared to his opposite number. However, Mahomes failed to throw at least one touchdown pass for the first time in five games, and his yardage total was his second-lowest of the campaign. Mahomes will look to bounce back in what will be an appreciably better environment for offense during a Week 13 road matchup against the Rams next Thursday night.

injury.comment: Burden caught three of seven targets for 44 yards in Thursday's 39-35 win over the Lions.
injury.longComment: The second-year wideout has taken a back seat to Rome Odunze coming out of Chicago's Week 10 bye. While Burden has managed just a 5-54-0 line on 10 targets over the last two games, Odunze topped those numbers on Thanksgiving alone with a 6-87-2 line on nine targets. Burden still has better overall numbers on the season, but the gap is closing rapidly. Colston Loveland (knee) left Thursday's game early, however, which could open up more volume for both of the Bears' top WRs. Burden will look to get rolling in Week 13 against the Jaguars.

injury.comment: Smith (back) was seen limping badly in the locker room after Thursday's 39-38 win over the Cowboys, Martin Frank of the Delaware News Journal reports.
injury.longComment: Smith put together a career stat line during the Eagles' Thanksgiving Day win, with the veteran wide receiver hauling in 11 of 14 targets for 200 yards and two touchdowns. He was in and out of the game after landing hard on his tailbone on one of his targets in the fourth quarter and was in noticeable pain when on the field. Smith will have additional time to rest courtesy of the Thursday game, but his status over the coming days will be worth monitoring ahead of the Eagles' Week 13 road tilt against the Cardinals on Sunday, Dec. 6.

injury.comment: Williams said after Thursday's 39-35 win in Detroit that he's "fine" and likely just has "a bruise on his abdomen," Jason Lieser of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.
injury.longComment: Williams seemingly went for a precautionary X-ray after Week 12 action due to a "weird fall" that occurred during Thursday's contest in which he engineered two TD drives in the final 8:20 of the fourth quarter to eke out a four-point victory. He completed 30 of 44 passes for 345 yards, two touchdowns and no interceptions and recorded three carries for 15 yards. With plenty of time to recover before the Bears' next game Sunday, Dec. 6 against the Jaguars, Williams has a decent chance to avoid practice restrictions next week.

injury.comment: Barkley suffered a stinger during Thursday's game in Dallas.
injury.longComment: This marks Barkley's second diagnosed stinger of the campaign, but on the previous occasion in Week 2 against the Titans, he was able to check back in to the contest. The Eagles may opt to exercise caution with Barkley, however, because he tended to a neck issue on a short week following this past Sunday's win against the Steelers.

injury.comment: Williams caught six of nine targets for 68 yards in Thursday's 39-35 loss to the Bears. He added 12 yards on his lone carry.
injury.longComment: The fifth-year wideout finished second on the Lions in targets, catches and receiving yards to Amon-Ra St. Brown (7-146-0 on 10 targets), a position that Williams is very used to finding himself in. Williams tied his season high in receptions with the performance, and he'll take a 42-679-6 line on 64 targets through 11 games into a Week 13 clash with the Falcons.

injury.comment: Goff completed 25 of 36 passes for 313 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Thursday's 39-35 loss to the Bears. He added 10 rushing yards on three carries.
injury.longComment: The veteran QB topped 300 passing yards for the fifth time this season, but Goff's only touchdown came on an 11-yard connection with Sam LaPorta in the second quarter, as Jahmyr Gibbs did most of the scoring for the Lions. Goff has thrown multiple TDs in just two of the last five games, a stretch in which he's managed a 7:5 TD:INT, but he could pop for a ceiling game in Week 13 against a struggling Falcons defense.

injury.comment: Moore hauled in two of six targets for 15 yards in the Bills' 13-10 win over the Chiefs on Thursday.
injury.longComment: Moore's production, like that of the rest of his fellow skill-position players, was very modest on a night when Josh Allen threw for only 81 yards and a pair of interceptions. The talented wideout's catch and yardage totals were both his third-lowest tallies of the season, but Moore is still averaging a formidable 14.6 yards per reception heading into a Week 13 road matchup against the Patriots on Sunday, Dec. 6.

injury.comment: Rice brought in two of five targets for 19 yards in the Chiefs' 13-10 loss to the Bills on Thursday.
injury.longComment: Rice's production was part of the collateral damage of a night that was unconducive for offense, as the veteran receiver tied his lowest reception and receiving yardage totals of the season for a non-injury-shortened game. Rice came in riding a solid four-game stretch where he'd generated a 23-237-1 line on 27 targets, and he'll look to return to that level of production during a Week 13 road matchup against the Rams next Thursday.

injury.comment: Monangai carried the ball eight times for 15 yards and two touchdowns and caught one of two targets for 14 yards in Thursday's 39-35 win over the Lions.
injury.longComment: Once again Monangai took a back seat to D'Andre Swift in terms of volume, but he punched in rushing scores from one and two yards out. The junior member of the Bears' backfield is up to five TDs on the season in six games, all on the ground, and Monangai's goal-line role keeps him fantasy-relevant heading into a Week 13 clash with the Jaguars.

injury.comment: Loveland (knee) is scheduled to undergo an MRI on Friday on the knee injury he sustained during Thursday's 39-35 win over the Bears, Ian Rapoport of ESPN and NFL Network reports.
injury.longComment: The Bears are hoping the results of Friday's MRI reveal a sprain rather than a tear, as the former outcome could lead to a relatively swift recovery, while the latter scenario could result in Loveland missing the rest of the season. Loveland got hurt in the first half of Thursday's comeback win. Prior to the injury, Loveland caught his only target for five yards but fumbled at the end of that play.

injury.comment: Kelce brought in four of seven targets for 71 yards in the Chiefs' 13-10 loss to the Bills on Thursday.
injury.longComment: Kelce, who shook off a hard hit to his lower back late in the first half, ended up posting a game-high receiving yardage total with the help of a game-long 24-yard grab that he made late in the first half, and he also tied for the team lead in receptions. The star tight end did have a couple of missed connections with Patrick Mahomes on fourth-quarter drives, however, plays that could have had an impact on the outcome of such a close game. Kelce has exceeded 65 receiving yards in four of the last five games heading into a Week 13 road showdown against the Rams next Thursday night.

injury.comment: Shipley carried the ball 10 times for 46 yards and failed to catch his only target in Thursday's 39-38 win over the Cowboys.
injury.longComment: Saquon Barkley (neck) exited the game early with a stinger, leaving the backfield in the hands of Shipley. The Eagles had to abandon the run game after halftime, however, limiting his usage as Joe Milton engineered an incredible comeback with his arm and legs. Barkley spent most of his time on the sideline trying to talk the coaching and training staffs into letting him back on the field, suggesting his absence was just precautionary, but if he misses additional action, Shipley could be in line for a much bigger workload in Week 13 against the Cardinals.

tg.callText: [strong] He played Sunday with the same foot/illness tag (4 carries and 3 kickoff returns against PIT), was limited in Monday's and Tuesday's walkthroughs (latest report Tue Nov 24, 2026), and Philly beat writers expect him to suit up Thursday, though not at 100%.

injury.comment: Johnson rushed once for two yards and caught seven of his eight targets for 55 yards in the Bills' 26-9 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Johnson did not carry the rock much at all in the contest. The running back did, however, rank third in receiving yards for Buffalo behind Khalil Shakir (101) and DJ Moore (91). Johnson should continue to see receiving opportunities in Week 12 against the Chiefs as the Bills' preferred third-down back.

injury.comment: Downs secured one of four targets for 13 yards in the Chiefs' 13-10 loss to the Bills on Thursday.
injury.longComment: After recording consecutive four-catch tallies following his trade from the Colts, Downs' production saw a downturn Thursday in a game where both air attacks performed below their usual levels. The talented receiver did make good use of his one reception, and Downs should be busier in a Week 13 road matchup against the Rams next Thursday night where weather shouldn't be a factor.

injury.comment: Milton completed 21 of 31 passes for 331 yards and three touchdowns with one interception in Thursday's 39-38 win over the Cowboys. He added 15 yards and a TD on three carries.
injury.longComment: Facing the team who put him on the practice squad to begin the season before he got signed by the Eagles, Milton used his mobility to keep plays alive and find receivers deep against an inept Cowboys secondary. The 26-year-old QB connected with DeVonta Smith for TDs of 50 yards in the second quarter and 45 yards in the third, before a big fourth quarter in which Milton ran in a 15-yard score of his own and then found Makai Lemon for a 15-yard strike as Philly erased a 38-24 deficit. Milton's 331 passing yards weren't just a career high, they were more than he produced in his first two starts this season combined. He'll remain under center against another struggling defense as he faces the Cardinals in Week 13.

injury.comment: Abdomen
Shakir brought in three of six targets for 33 yards in the Bills' 13-10 in over the Chiefs on Thursday.
injury.longComment: Shakir's reception and yardage totals led the Bills on a night when Josh Allen threw for just 81 yards with a pair of picks. The veteran slot receiver was coming off a Week 11 showing against the Dolphins in which he accrued a season-high 101 receiving yards, and Thursday's downturn was largely explainable by Allen's struggles and less-than-ideal weather conditions. Shakir should remain a key target for Allen during a Week 13 road matchup Sunday, Dec. 6 with a Patriots squad that the wideout posted a 7-82-0 line against back in Week 4.

injury.comment: Kincaid brought in both targets for 13 yards in the Bills' 13-10 loss to the Chiefs on Thursday.
injury.longComment: Making his return from a one-game absence due to thumb and ankle injuries, Kincaid's numbers weren't quite as poor within the context of a night where Josh Allen threw for only 81 yards and completed less than 50.0 percent of his passes. Kincaid tied for runner-up slotting on the Bills in receptions, and he was third in receiving yards as well. Kincaid now has multiple catches in five straight games heading into a Week 13 road divisional matchup against the Patriots on Sunday, Dec. 6.

injury.comment: Vaki carried the ball six times for 19 yards and hauled in two of his three targets for a loss of four yards during Detroit's loss to Chicago on Thursday.
injury.longComment: Vaki once again served a limited role as Jahmyr Gibbs continues to handle the bulk of the workload. The 25-year-old has totaled 181 rushing yards on 43 carries, in addition to catching 11 of his 13 targets for 84 yards across 11 games this season.

injury.comment: Odunze caught six of nine targets for 87 yards and two touchdowns in Thursday's 39-35 win over the Lions.
injury.longComment: The third-year wideout played hero in the fourth quarter on Thanksgiving. With the Bears down 35-24, Odunze hauled in a 41-yard strike from Caleb Williams (abdomen)  and then went up for a six-yard score in the back corner of the end zone with just three seconds left on the clock. Odunze sports a 42-660-3 line on 64 targets through 11 games, and if Colston Loveland (knee) ends up missing more time after exiting Thursday's game early, there could be more looks available for him in a Week 13 tilt against the Jaguars.

injury.comment: Flournoy caught just one pass for 11 yards on one target in Sunday's 51-30 win over the Titans.
injury.longComment: The Cowboys' slot receiver drew just one look on Dak Prescott's 33 pass attempts. He'd caught multiple passes in all 10 games leading up to Sunday's contest. A favorite target of Prescott in the red zone, Flournoy will try to rebound at home against the Eagles on Thanksgiving, when he'll be playable on three-game fantasy slates for Thursday.

injury.comment: Johnson (ankle) has been ruled out  for Thursday's game against the Lions.
injury.longComment: Johnson injured his ankle in Sunday's win over the Saints, and with the quick turnaround for Week 12, he won't be available against the Lions. The Bears will roll with D'Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai as their only healthy backs for Thursday's game.

tg.callText: [strong] The Bears' final injury report on Wednesday, Nov. 25, 2026 officially ruled him out (ankle) for Thursday against the Lions; he did not practice all week after being carted off with the ankle injury in Sunday's win over the Saints. The earlier Questionable listings came before this final report.

injury.comment: LaPorta caught four of five targets for 44 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 39-35 loss to the Bears.
injury.longComment: Despite the high score, Jared Goff threw only one TD pass on the afternoon, connecting with LaPorta for an 11-yard strike in the second quarter, The tight end snapped a five-game touchdown drought in the process, but he still hasn't topped four catches or 62 yards in six contests since Detroit's bye. LaPorta will take a 43-521-4 line on 64 targets through 11 games into a Week 13 clash with the Falcons.

injury.comment: McKee (ribs) was a full participant at the Eagles' walkthrough practice Tuesday.
injury.longComment: McKee was estimated to be a limited participant on Monday's injury report due to an injury to his ribs. He now looks to be all set to serve as the team's primary reserve option at quarterback behind starter Joe Milton on Thursday against the Cowboys.

injury.comment: Blue returned his lone kickoff for 23 yards but fumbled the ball in the process during the Eagles' 19-16 win over the Steelers on Sunday.
injury.longComment: The loose ball was recovered by the Steelers, and Pittsburgh's offense turned that takeaway into a 40-yard field goal by Chris Boswell four plays later. It ended up being the only touch of the game for Blue, who played all 11 of his snaps on special teams. There's an outside chance he sees some involvement on offense against the Cowboys on Thanksgiving Day, but that will depend on the availability of both Saquon Barkley (neck/illness) and Will Shipley (foot/illness).

injury.comment: Goedert (shoulder) had his right arm in a sling following Thursday's 39-38 victory over the Cowboys, Jimmy Kempski of PhillyVoice.com reports.
injury.longComment: Goedert injured his right shoulder during the first half of Thursday's game and was not cleared to return. He'll undergo further tests to determine the severity of the injury, but the veteran tight end is certainly in jeopardy of not being available for the Eagles' Week 13 road tilt against the Cardinals on Sunday, Dec. 6. Johnny Mundt, Zach Ertz and rookie second-rounder Eli Stowers would all be in line for larger roles on offense if Goedert were to miss time.

injury.comment: Keenum (coach's decision) is inactive and tabbed as the Bears' emergency third quarterback Thursday in Detroit.
injury.longComment: Keenum will fill the Bears' emergency quarterback role for a sixth consecutive week. He'll be able to enter Thursday's contest only if both Caleb Williams and Tyson Bagent have to exit due to injury, illness or ejection.

injury.comment: Nussmeier (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Chiefs' emergency third quarterback against the Bills on Thursday.
injury.longComment: Nussmeier has yet to appear in a game this season but will once again serve as the team's emergency quarterback. The rookie seventh-round pick will only be able to play against Buffalo if both Patrick Mahomes and Justin Fields leave the game due to injury, illness or ejection.

injury.comment: Payton (coach's decision) is inactive for Thursday's game at Dallas but is available as the Eagles' emergency third quarterback.
injury.longComment: Payton will only take the field in Week 12 if starter Joe Milton and backup Tanner McKee leave the contest due to injury, illness or ejection.

injury.comment: Calf
Ahmed was elevated from the practice squad to the Bears' active roster Wednesday, Brad Biggs of the Chicago Tribune reports.
injury.longComment: Roschon Johnson (ankle) was ruled out for Thursday's game, leaving the Bears with only two healthy options in the backfield going into Thanksgiving. With that, Ahmed will be up from the practice squad for the divisional tilt against the Lions.

injury.comment: Wrist
Undisclosed
The Cowboys elevated Corbin from the practice squad Wednesday.
injury.longComment: The running back will again be active as Javonte Williams' backup after rushing five times for 32 yards, adding one catch for five yards on one target, across 18 offensive snaps last Sunday against the Titans.

injury.comment: Knee - ACL + MCL
Hip
Saylors recorded 29-yard kickoff return during Sunday's 31-21 win over Tampa Bay.
injury.longComment: Saylors didn't record any stats over two snaps on offense while recording 29 yards on his only kick return of the day in Week 11. The running back will continue to be unintriguing fantasy option while operating as an extreme depth option behind Jahmyr Gibbs and Sione Vaki in Detroit's backfield moving forward.

injury.comment: Back
Ott logged five rushing attempts for 12 yards and logged one tackle on kick coverage in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Ott logged 12 offensive snaps and eight special-teams snaps in Sunday's contest. The running back saw a few carries behind Emmett Johnson due to the absence of Kenneth Walker (groin). With Walker likely returning for Thursday night's game against the Bills, Ott may not see the field on offense in that contest.

injury.comment: The Chiefs elevated Carter from the practice squad to the active roster ahead of Thursday's game against the Bills, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
injury.longComment: It's the third and final time Carter is eligible to be elevated from the practice squad, so he would need to be signed to the 53-man roster in order to suit up for the Chiefs beyond Week 12. With Kenneth Walker (groin) out for a third consecutive game, Carter will operate as Kansas City's RB3 behind Emmett Johnson and Jaydn Ott.

injury.comment: Hamstring
The Chiefs placed VanSumeren (knee) on the reserve/injured list Tuesday.
injury.longComment: VanSumeren didn't practice Tuesday due to a sprained knee that will now keep him out for at least the next four weeks, according to Matt McMullen of the Chiefs' official site. In six regular-season games in 2026, the fourth-year pro played a majority of his reps on special teams, with just six of 104 total snaps coming on offense.

injury.comment: Lemon caught five of six targets for 51 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 39-38 win over the Cowboys.
injury.longComment: The Eagles were down 28-10 at the half and watched Saquon Barkley (neck) and Dallas Goedert (shoulder) exit early, leaving Joe Milton with limited tools at his disposal to put together a comeback. DeVonta Smith saw most of the target volume, but Lemon came up big when it counted, connecting with Milton on a 24-yard TD that brought Philly to within two points with about two minutes left. While a two-point conversion attempt to tie the game failed, the stage was set for a game-winning 59-yard field goal by Jake Elliott in the dying seconds. Lemon has topped 50 yards in four of the last five games, producing a 25-249-2 line on 35 targets over that stretch, and the rookie's role could continue to grow in Week 13 against the Cardinals.

injury.comment: Coleman didn't catch his only target in Thursday's 13-10 win over the Chiefs.
injury.longComment: Coleman's involvement was minimal with DJ Moore healthy, as has been the case throughout the season. Josh Allen threw for just 81 yards Thursday, so none of Buffalo's receivers were particularly effective, but it would likely take another injury to Moore for Coleman to return to relevance in fantasy. Coleman hasn't exceeded 17 yards in a game or scored since Week 6. Up next for Coleman and the Bills is a Week 13 trip to New England.

injury.comment: Worthy didn't corral any of his three targets during Thursday's 13-10 loss at Buffalo.
injury.longComment: Since Josh Downs arrived via trade from Indianapolis at the deadline, Rashee Rice is leading all Chiefs wide receivers in targets with 17 over the last three contests, followed by Downs' 14, Worthy's 10, Cyrus Allen's nine, Jalen Royals' (ankle) two and Andrew Armstrong's two. Worthy's average number of targets has reduced from 5.9 per game pre-Downs to 3.3 since the addition to the position group, and the former has just a 2-38-1 line during that span. As a result, Worthy is difficult to trust as Kansas City prepares to face the Rams on the road next Thursday.

injury.comment: Cooper caught one of his two targets for 14 yards during the Eagles' win over the Cowboys on Thursday.
injury.longComment: Cooper had a quiet outing despite the win as he finished fourth on the team in both receiving yards and receptions. Across 10 games this season, the 25-year-old has caught 17 passes for 259 yards and four touchdowns, all of which serve as new career highs.

injury.comment: Raymond caught three of his five targets for 20 yards during Chicago's win over the Lions on Thursday.
injury.longComment: Raymond had a solid outing against his former team, as he finished tied for fourth on the Bears in receptions. The 32-year-old has now caught 36 passes for 324 yards and a touchdown, in addition to racking up 209 punt-return yards across 11 games this season.

injury.comment: Allen caught two of four targets for 41 yards during Sunday's 34-7 win over the Cardinals.
injury.longComment: Allen was able to reel in multiple passes for the second straight week after having done so only twice in the team's first eight games of the year. The wide receiver played 16 offensive snaps which ranked sixth at his position behind Xavier Worthy (47), Rashee Rice (32), Jalen Royals (24), Andrew Armstrong (20) and Josh Downs (17). As a result of the depth of the WR room in Kansas City, Allen will remain a hard fantasy option to trust Thursday versus the Bills.

injury.comment: Thomas brought in two of three targets for 56 yards and added a 30-yard carry during the Bears' 21-13 win over the Saints on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Thomas was cleared to play Sunday after working through an ankle issue that prevented him from practicing Friday. The ankle didn't appear to bother him, as he turned his first touch of the game into a 30-yard rush midway through the second quarter before connecting with Caleb Williams for 40 and 16 yards in the third and fourth quarters, respectively. It was the rookie third-round wideout's best performance of the season, and while Chicago boasts talented pass catchers like Luther Burden, Rome Odunze and Colston Loveland, Thomas' big-play potential could be something that the Bears lean into for Thanksgiving Day against the Lions, whose defense ranks 27th in the NFL in passing yards allowed per game (233.1) and 29th in passing touchdowns allowed (21).

injury.comment: Turpin failed to reel in his only target while rushing twice for 41 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 51-30 win over the Titans. He added 121 yards as a kick returner and logged a 13-yard punt return.
injury.longComment: Turpin went without a catch for the fourth time this season, but he was able to make his mark as a rusher in Week 11. The wideout was able to break loose for a 22-yard rushing touchdown in the first quarter, notching his second score on the ground this season. Turpin has now caught five of 11 targets for 49 yards, rushed five times for 60 yards and two touchdowns, and added 695 kick-return yards and 121 yards as a punt returner over eight contests so far during the 2026 season.

injury.comment: Knox didn't catch his only target in Thursday's 13-10 win over the Chiefs.
injury.longComment: Knox finished without a catch while Dalton Kincaid caught both of his targets in the latter's return from a one-game absence due to thumb and ankle injuries. Josh Allen threw for just 81 yards in difficult weather conditions, but Knox hasn't contributed much as a pass catcher even when Allen has been slinging the ball effectively. Heading into a Week 13 trip to New England, Knox has caught 16 of 24 targets for 117 yards and one TD through 11 appearances.

injury.comment: Head coach Andy Reid said Royals suffered a sprained ankle during Thursday's 13-10 loss in Buffalo, Charles Goldman of AtoZSports.com reports.
injury.longComment: Royals left the game in the third quarter and was ruled out not long afterward due to an ankle injury. The severity of the sprain will determine if Royals is in danger of missing any time. If that comes to pass for Royals, Andrew Armstrong likely will be on track for a few more offensive snaps behind Rashee Rice, Josh Downs, Xavier Worthy and Cyrus Allen.

injury.comment: Shavers failed to bring in either of his two targets and logged one tackle on kick coverage in the Bills' 26-9 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Shavers played 27 offensive snaps and 16 special-teams in his return to the field Sunday. The wide receiver has finally started to mix into the offense after recovering from the torn ACL he suffered in the Bills' 27-24 wild-card win over the Jaguars last January.

Mingo (ankle) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Eagles.
injury.longComment: Mingo's absence for Thanksgiving Day will be his third missed game in a row due to an ankle injury that he sustained in Week 9 against the Colts. His absence means KaVontae Turpin and Camden Brown will continue to operate in rotational roles on offense behind CeeDee Lamb, George Pickens and Ryan Flournoy. Mingo's next opportunity to play is Week 13 against the Seahawks on Monday, Dec. 7.

injury.comment: TeSlaa failed to catch any of his three targets during Sunday's 31-21 win over the Buccaneers.
injury.longComment: TeSlaa went without a reception for the second time in four weeks, and he has now gone six straight games without exceeding 20 receiving yards. The wide receiver played 23 snaps on offense, ranking third at his position behind Amon-Ra St. Brown (46) and Jameson Williams (45). TeSlaa will continue to be an unreliable fantasy option ahead of the team's Week 12 matchup with the Bears on Thursday.

Spann-Ford caught his lone target for 15 yards during Dallas' loss to the Eagles on Thursday.
injury.longComment: Spann-Ford served as the team's starting tight end for the third consecutive game as Jake Ferguson remains sidelined with a knee injury. However, Spann-Ford had a quiet outing but will look to play a larger role next week versus the Seahawks if Ferguson is out again.

injury.comment: Gray (ribs) is active for Thursday's game against the Bills.
injury.longComment: Gray injured his ribs against the Cardinals on Sunday, and after logging full practices Tuesday and Wednesday, the sixth-year tight end has been cleared by medical staff to play on Thanksgiving Day. He has a 19-211-1 receiving line on 25 targets through 10 regular-season games while operating as the Chiefs' TE2 behind Travis Kelce.

injury.comment: Mitchell recorded two receptions for 40 yards on two targets in Sunday's 51-30 win over the Titans.
injury.longComment: The fifth-year tight end was one of eight pass catchers that quarterback Dak Prescott connected with on the afternoon, with the pair of receptions marking Mitchell's first two grabs of the season. Mitchell took the field for 15 of the Cowboys' 65 snaps on offense, but he could wind up seeing most of his playing time on special teams once top tight end Jake Ferguson is cleared to return from the knee injury that has sidelined him for the past two games.

injury.comment: Latu recorded a 30-yard reception on four targets in Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
injury.longComment: With Dalton Kincaid (thumb) inactive, Latu moved a rung up on the ladder at tight end and ended up seeing his most extensive playing time on offense of the season, logging 28 of 78 snaps (36 percent). He parlayed the elevated snaps into a season-high target count, but Latu's lone reception actually came on special teams, when Tommy Doman faked a punt and connected with the 24-year-old deep down the field for a fourth-down conversion. Latu will likely see his opportunities take a hit if Kincaid makes it back for a Thursday matchup with the Chiefs in Week 12.

injury.comment: Roush caught all five of his targets for 31 yards in Thursday's 39-35 win over the Lions.
injury.longComment: Colston Loveland exited the game early with a knee injury, and as a result Roush wound up posting the best numbers of his brief career. The 2026 third-round pick hadn't caught more than two passes in a game prior to Thanksgiving, but with Cole Kmet (knee) already done for the season, a serious injury to Loveland would plant Roush at the top of the depth chart at tight end heading into a Week 13 clash with the Jaguars.

injury.comment: Carlson caught two of his four targets for 30 yards during Chicago's win over the Lions on Thursday.
injury.longComment: Carlson hadn't caught a pass across his previous three appearances this season but benefited from increased playing time after Colston Loveland (knee) exited the game in the first quarter. Carlson could continue to see increased usage if Loveland is forced to miss extended time.

injury.longComment: With Jake Ferguson (knee) remaining out for Dallas, Schoonmaker played 25 of 65 offensive snaps behind Brevyn Spann-Ford. Schoonmaker ran 12 routes, five fewer than Spann-Ford, and the duo combined to see three targets on a day Dak Prescott attempted 33 passes. Schoonmaker has five catches for 48 yards on six targets across nine games this season and has no fantasy appeal.

injury.longComment: One of Wright's two grabs in Week 11 was a 27-yard strike up the seam, easily his longest reception of the season thus far. He was on the field for 43 of the Lions' 58 offensive snaps Sunday, but he spent a substantial majority of those on blocking assignments for tailback Jahmyr Gibbs and company. His role in a Thanksgiving tilt versus the Bears may depend somewhat on the health of running mate Sam LaPorta, who was limited during Monday's walkthrough with an ankle issue.

injury.longComment: FitzPatrick signed with the Chiefs' practice squad Nov. 17, and he'll now be available to make his 2026 regular-season debut to provide depth at tight end in the event that Noah Gray (ribs) cannot play Thursday. FitzPatrick appeared in 15 regular-season games for the Packers in 2025 and posted a 12-72-1 receiving line on 15 targets.

injury.comment: Stowers didn't log any offensive snaps in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.
injury.longComment: Dallas Goedert (47 snaps), Johnny Mundt (eight) and Zach Ertz (six) handled tight-end duties for Philly, while Stowers played 20 snaps on special teams. The rookie tight end is miles from fantasy relevance this season.
